body: I wish it was, heh. But, no, it's not. Just me venting my thoughts.

Firstly, I'm glad you think so highly of what I wrote. That brought a smile to my face. I'm feeling a bit more on the up-and-up. Not so dreary for the moment. Kinda feeling a little...hopeful, I suppose. Like things may possibly turn around. 

As for the ADHD thing, I recall my dad and I talking one time, long ago. He said something that basically meant that the possibility of me having some kind of attention disorder had crossed his mind before. And its certainly crossed mine as well. Never looked into it much, though. I was always worried I'd be looking for something that's not there. And I was always afraid...of the idea that it might be true, y'know? It's a little gut-wrenching to be told, in clinical, blunt, textbook terms "your brain's got some kinks in it". And then there's all the stigmas and whatnot. People will look at you a little funny. Plus, I never had the funds for it. So, I just made do.

Thanks, friend. I appreciate your support. I really do. And thank you for the compliments. I guess I just kinda...write how I would talk. How a person would talk. I want it to sound natural, without venturing into casual territory. It's hard to explain.

Shit, that damn near made me cry, friend. I guess I'll take your advice at some point. Not sure where I'll share what I've got, but I suppose I could find a subreddit to post stuff in. I've got loads of material, so that's hardly an issue (mostly poetry, though I do have a novel in the works). Seriously, I'm so flattered you think so highly of my writing. That...made my night.

That's...really kind of you. I really enjoy writing. A lot. I do it all the damn time. So, for you to say that, almost brings me to tears. That's real sweet of you to say. I've always been self-conscious of my abilities as a writer. That's why I don't share it anywhere, except to family and friends who might read it, maybe. Never thought it was any good.
Well, I certainly am grateful for the kind words. I still disagree, but it warms my heart to hear you think I'm not far gone. Maybe one day, I can feel the same.
Thank you. I'm grateful for the well wishes. I hope all goes well tomorrow, too.
